title: DeploymentOptions
summary: Build identity, manifest URL and optional recovery policy.

sections.title: Fields
sections.body: version identifies the loaded browser graph. Generated shared and routes fingerprints allow compatible destinations to keep client navigation. manifestURL points to the deployed manifest. timeout defaults to 2000 ms. checkInterval defaults to 30000 ms for successful checks with generated metadata; chunk failures bypass it. reload overrides document navigation. Legacy version-only metadata remains supported conservatively. Use generated metadata rather than inventing route fingerprints.
